title: The Better Covenant: Hebrews
subtitle: Hebrews 1-13
theme: Jesus is the fulfillment of every type, shadow, and promise in the Old Testament.
memoryText: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses… Let us then with confidence draw near to the throne of grace.
reviewQuestions: How does Hebrews demonstrate that Jesus is better than angels, Moses, and the Levitical priesthood?
What is the relationship between the Old Covenant and the New Covenant?
What does it mean that Christ is our high priest after the order of Melchizedek?
What does Hebrews 11 teach us about the nature of faith?
